items.title: Commissioner rebukes claim pro-Palestinian groups tried to 'hijack' hearing
items.description: The royal commission on antisemitism has hit back at comments from a prominent member of the Jewish community who accused pro-Palestinian groups of attempting to "hijack" the inquiry using "clickbait theatrics and gratuitous slurs".

items.title: EV sales keep nudging record high as market hit 'new phase'
items.description: Over the past year, electric car sales have tripled, as anxiety about fuel shortages and rising petrol prices continues.

items.title: NSW Police update body-worn camera policy after ABC investigation
items.description: Thousands of NSW Police officers will from today be required to switch on their body-worn cameras when using police powers.

items.title: 'List of doom' outlines birds facing extinction if deadly flu spreads
items.description: A list of thousands of Australian species have been ranked by threat level as the deadly H5 bird flu spreads.

items.title: Mandatory domestic roaming to be key focus of mobile coverage inquiry
items.description: Consumer and regional advocates are urging the government to intervene and mandate domestic roaming now, arguing the ACCC's 12-month inquiry will take too long.

items.title: Jetstar to scrap free 7kg carry-on for new overhead luggage fees
items.description: Jetstar has announced it will charge passengers to stow carry-on luggage in overhead lockers from next year, allowing only a small under-seat bag at no extra cost.

items.title: Labor was poised to reveal massive migration cuts, then suddenly delayed
items.description: The ABC understands the cuts to migration numbers are contentious within Labor, but no reason for the delay is given.

items.title: 'My brother has megarexia': Unregulated peptides exacerbating male eating disorders
items.description: Eating disorder dietician Alex Rodrigues said unregulated peptides being sold or shared in gym communities is a concerning trend in Australia.

items.title: A high-profile rape conviction puts suppression orders back on the agenda
items.description: Much like the high-profile case of Tom Silvagni last year, celebrity agent Ralph Carr's legal quest to protect his name has put issues of open justice and suppression orders in Victoria back on the agenda.

items.title: Corruption probe into Andrews-era firefighters negotiations handed down
items.description: The IBAC report into a bitter pay dispute between the Victorian government and firefighters during the Andrews era found United Firefighters Union boss Peter Marshall had privileged access to government figures, but stopped short of any finding of corrupt conduct.

items.title: NAPLAN results are out. Here's what they mean
items.description: NAPLAN results have arrived for students across Australia, giving parents a snapshot of how their child is tracking in literacy and numeracy. But what do the scores really mean and when should parents be concerned?

items.title: Bondi Junction recommendations accepted by NSW government
items.description: The NSW government has announced it will accept all recommendations directed towards it from the Westfield Bondi Junction coronial inquest, six months after the findings were handed down.

items.title: Older women 'lost in housing crisis' as thousands seek support
items.description: Get financial assistance? Move forward. Feeling unsafe? Back you go. For older women facing housing insecurity, navigating the ups and downs can be like a game of snakes and ladders.

items.title: These 10 Aussie wildflowers have superpowers. Pick your favourite
items.description: Move over waratahs and banksias! These 10 flowers from the unsung understorey are not just pretty faces, they have surprising tricks up their sleeves.

items.title: 'A lifelong wound': What happens when kids are parentified
items.description: Eve was an adult when she realised she grew up in a home where the child-adult relationships were reversed.

items.title: Richard Gere's son Homer steps into the spotlight in The Shards
items.description: Netflix's six-episode adaptation of Miles Franklin's beloved novel features former Home and Away star Philippa Northeast as the firey protagonist.

items.title: 'Shocking': Hospital inquiry urges axing of public-private partnership
items.description: A parliamentary committee has handed down its findings after an investigation into a Newcastle hospital where staff reported maggots falling from the ceiling.

items.title: Police seek to solve a decades-old mystery of man's body found in car
items.description: NSW Police are still trying to solve the case of a man whose body was found in a car with WA number plates from a vehicle written off years earlier.

items.title: Live: ASX briefly hits new record high
items.description: SpaceX's results beat analyst estimates, but the firm is yet to turn a profit. Meanwhile, the Australian share market started its day higher on hopes the US and Iran will reach a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Pressure has eased on the Japanese yen after intervention. Follow live.

items.title: 'Noose is tightening': One Nation's new Victorian leader promoted conspiracy
items.description: The new state One Nation leader warned of a debunked "globalist" plot to control Australians.

items.title: High Court throws out reduced sentence for teen who killed Emma Lovell
items.description: The High Court of Australia throws out a reduced sentence handed to a 17-year-old jailed over the murder of Brisbane woman Emma Lovell.

items.title: Diarrhoea parasite spreads across US as more than 10,000 cases recorded
items.description: At least two people have died amid a growing outbreak of the Cyclospora parasite, linked to contaminated lettuce.

items.title: 'The world must see': Zelenskyy shares video of drone hunting vegetable seller
items.description: Ukraine accuses Russia of committing a war crime after video is released showing a drone chasing down and wounding a vegetable seller in the southern city of Kherson. Footage shows the drone pursuing a man around a van being used as a street stand, before diving towards him and exploding as he ducks for cover behind the vehicle. The man, identified only as Yurii, survived but suffered shock and shrapnel injuries, according to Ukrainian officials.

items.title: Gas giant prosecuted after under-reporting toxic emissions
items.description: Japanese gas giant Inpex has been charged by the Northern Territory's environmental regulator for under-reporting the amount of toxic emissions it released from the Ichthys facility near Darwin.

items.title: Netanyahu says IDF will not withdraw from Gaza until Hamas has fully disarmed
items.description: Benjamin Netanyahu's remarks are intended to push back against a recent deal to disarm Hamas announced by US President Donald Trump, which was seen as a potential breakthrough for ending the war.
